checked.check: Pre-push hook: network, arguments, push/reset/file changes (EXTRA 3)
checked.how: Read .githooks/pre-push whole (48 lines); git diff --name-status e0a425b f72eaa7 -- .githooks (one line changed, file read at the head)
checked.result: The hook reads the four fields of git's stdin only to see whether a pushed object is non-zero; it uses no argument ($1, $2) and does not put stdin text into a command. It calls only `git rev-parse --show-toplevel`, `command -v npm`, `cd "$root/tools"` (quoted) and `npm run check`. No git push, reset, checkout, commit, no file write, no curl. Network: only what `npm run check` does; the check script chain is format:check, lint, traces, handoffs-check, test, e2e (tools/package.json line 29), no install step. Met. What the tests and e2e of tools/ write on the owner's machine is not read here (tests are a coverage matter; no run exists for the work line).

Default token rights `read`, `can_approve_pull_request_reviews` false (met). Fork approval `all_external_contributors` (met, recorded in ISS-0052 as done). `allowed_actions: all` and `sha_pinning_required: false`: covered by the open defect ISS-0052 (items 2 and 3), not reported again. No dependabot.yml (.github has only workflows/): covered by ISS-0052 item 1. Fork PR settings for private repos: HTTP 422 (not applicable to a public repository). Branch protection of main: see SEC-CI-01 (not covered by ISS-0052: that defect records it as enabled). Secret scanning: see SEC-CI-02. Forks of the repository: 0. Retention of logs: 90 days (default).

checked.check: What app.yml's filters mean for a fork (EXTRA 2)
checked.how: Read on: of app.yml; git diff --name-status b64562a f72eaa7 -- .github (app.yml added, check.yml modified)
checked.result: app.yml has no pull_request trigger, so a pull request from a fork never runs it: no docker, no Postgres container and no Chrome run for fork code, and the `pg`, `docker` and `e2e` jobs are reachable only by a push to main or ci/**, which needs write access to the repository (a fork pushes to its own repository, where the workflow runs with the fork's own rights and secrets, not Sai's). Consequence: a fork PR that changes app/ is checked only by check.yml (tools/), never by app.yml; this is a coverage gap, not a security hole, because main is the only place that matters and it is reached by the owner's push. Met for security; the gap is noted in SEC-CI-01 because without branch protection nothing forces any check before main.

findings.check: Repository settings of Actions and the branch (extra check 1); decisions 0048, 0110, 0111
findings.title: Branch protection of main is off, although the recorded decision 0048 (and ISS-0052) say it was switched on and decisions 0110 and 0111 rely on it
findings.where: GitHub repository settings, branch main (read with gh api); decisions/0048-owner-delegates-open-points-repo-public.md; docs/issues/ISS-0052-github-actions-hardening.md (section «Сделано 2026-10-13»); decisions/0110-run-checks-on-github.md line 29; decisions/0111-repository-open-on-purpose.md line 29
findings.evidence: gh api repos/<repo>/branches/main -q '{protected,protection}' -> {"protected":false,"protection":{"enabled":false,"required_status_checks":{"checks":[],"contexts":[],"enforcement_level":"off"}}}; gh api repos/<repo>/branches/main/protection -> HTTP 404 {"message":"Branch not protected"}; gh api repos/<repo>/rulesets -> []; gh api repos/<repo>/rules/branches/main -> []; the token of this PC has permissions admin:true, so the 404 is not a lack of rights. ISS-0052: «защита ветки main включена: обязательная проверка check, force-push и удаление ветки запрещены, enforce_admins = false»; decision 0111: «It does not change check.yml, the branch protection...». Not covered by an open defect: ISS-0052 records the protection as done, so it does not report its loss; ISS-0057 is only about README words.
findings.item: R1 (main gets only a checked, released result), Q7 (the repository is public)
findings.recommendation: Owner decision (settings of GitHub are changed only with the owner's word, decision 0048 limits): ask whether the protection was switched off on purpose. If not, switch it on again as in 0048: required status check `check`, no force-push, no deletion of main, enforce_admins false. If it was removed on purpose, record that in a decision and correct ISS-0052, ISS-0057, decisions 0110/0111 and README, which still assume it. A cheap guard: a read-only `gh api repos/<repo>/branches/main/protection` line in the release checklist (RELEASE-FINALIZER) so a lost protection is seen before a push.

findings.check: Repository settings (secret scanning) on a public repository
findings.title: Secret scanning, push protection and Dependabot security updates are all disabled on a public repository
findings.evidence: gh api repos/<repo> -q '{visibility,security_and_analysis}' -> visibility public; secret_scanning disabled; secret_scanning_push_protection disabled; secret_scanning_non_provider_patterns disabled; secret_scanning_validity_checks disabled; dependabot_security_updates disabled. ISS-0052 names allowed_actions, sha_pinning and dependabot.yml only, not these switches.
findings.recommendation: Owner decision: switch on secret scanning with push protection (free for public repositories) and Dependabot security updates; they cost no money and add a second net after the local traces check. Add the settings to ISS-0052 or to a new defect so they are decided together.

findings.check: Pinning of what the jobs download (actions and runtime)
findings.title: check.yml installs a floating Node 22 (`check-latest: true`, added after e0a425b), while app.yml pins Node 22.23.4
findings.evidence: check.yml: `node-version: "22"` + `check-latest: true`; app.yml: `node-version: "22.23.4"` in all four jobs; git diff e0a425b f72eaa7 -- .github/workflows/check.yml shows the added `+          check-latest: true`. The job `check` runs fork code (pull_request) and installs the newest 22.x on every run, so the toolchain of the main check is not the one of the record of main (the log of the run records the version, but nothing pins it).
findings.item: Q7 (supply chain of the check), Q10
findings.recommendation: Decide on purpose: either pin `22.23.4` in check.yml as in app.yml (the floor of tools/src/node-floor.js is 22.23.4) or keep the floating version and write the reason in the file next to the line. The change in check.yml needs the work of WF-02, not an edit by the auditor.

summary.text: The workflows are tight: read-only token everywhere, no pull_request_target, no secrets in the repository, no untrusted text in a shell line, all actions pinned by a full hash that matches the tag, images pinned by a digest, passwords made in the run and masked, and a pre-push hook that only runs the check and never pushes or changes files. The one real problem is not in a file: the branch protection of main that decisions 0048, 0110 and 0111 rely on is off today. Two Low points: secret scanning is off on the public repository, and check.yml floats the Node version. The settings allowed_actions=all, sha_pinning_required=false and the missing dependabot.yml are the open defect ISS-0052 and are not reported again.
